Subsequently, the patient was given a maintenance prescription of oral methylprednisolone (1 mg/kg bodyweight with slow tapering) and idebenone tablets (90 mg/d). After 2 weeks, the patient’s headache and blurred vision symptoms gradually improved, and he was discharged from the hospital.
